pages.summary: The cloud based legal practice management software that makes running your firm, organizing cases, and collaborating with clients from one place possible.
pages.body:
![](/img/76b98e89b54aa231)

The cloud-based legal practice management software that makes running your firm, organizing cases, and collaborating with clients from one place possible.

# Overview

### I. Do more billable work

![](/img/58d1a43b905d01c7)

Make the most of your time, while Clio automates tasks, minimizes paperwork, and eliminates redundancies. Streamline day-to-day tasks, so you can get back to what matters most.

### II. Take the guesswork out of business decisions

![](/img/85d547175fa0452f)

Work in compliance with regulatory standards using straightforward financial tools. Improve your processes and profit—it’s a win, win.

### III. Deliver the service your clients want

![](/img/a90253b5bc68b9f7)

Accommodate your clients with flexible e-signatures, online payments, and more. Clio helps you with the moving parts of case management, so you can focus on your clients.

### IV. Make it easier for clients to pay

![](/img/7cd8295d3fa49b85)

Clio helps provide a client-centered billing that gets you paid faster. Accept online payments in accordance with trust accounting rules, set flexible payment plans, and more.

# LEGAL CASE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE

Use our case management software for case organization, time tracking, document management, calendaring, and billing—no matter where you are.

Get an overview of all case information from a single dashboard. Link every contact, document, calendar event, note, time entry, and bill to the appropriate case to make your law practice management tasks flow as smoothly as possible. Work on your cases from any computer with an internet connection or download the mobile app. Improve your workflow and minimize the time spent doing menial tasks so you can focus on those that count for your law practice.

![](/img/b041c81fa173d7a2)

## 1. Reduce redundant tasks

Enter data once and easily access what you need to work on your cases and make our tools an integral part of your law practice management process. Use our software for document management, billing, time tracking, and more: Get it all done faster, and with less risk of error, and focus on the tasks that are the most important to your legal practice.

## 2. Access every case detail from anywhere

Log in to your online legal case management tools to access documents, bills, client contact info, and more from any computer with an internet connection—or download our mobile app.

Access your matters, documents, contacts, notes, and calendar from your mobile device.

![](/img/4412926e9c59c7d4)

### I. Be more productive away from your desk

Pull up cases, key documents (in fullscreen), and calendars in court, in transit, in line for coffee—wherever you are.

### II. Increase profitability—bill as you work

Capture more billable and non-billable time by doing it on the spot. Use different categories for time and expenses, add UTBMS codes, duplicate entries, and more.

### III. Simplify recordkeeping on the go

Break the habit of costly, duplicate data entry. Create events, notes, tasks, add documents, and more in real time—all with a single tap. Use text snippets or dictation for even quicker data input.

![](/img/8942ee300e66947c)

### IV. Navigate deeper into legal matters with ease

Ensure case and client information is readily available—and follow-up happens in seconds. Email, call, and get directions to a client all with a single tap.

### V. Stay on top of your day, and ahead of schedule.

See your schedule from a day, month, or personal agenda view. View events, gaps and conflicts in your day—even access Tasks and Statutes of Limitations from your calendar.

### VI. Stay connected to your firm from your pocket

Get full visibility into firm ongoings from your mobile device. Use Clio as your secure internal messaging tool, and receive push notifications as updates happen.

## 3. Add case information from existing software (integrations)

Log emails, file legal documents, and sync case details to Clio from over 200 other apps and software including Outlook, GSuite, and Dropbox. Benefit from full integration for increased flexibility and more fluid processing of legal cases.

Save time, reduce double-data entry, and prevent human error while working in popular business and productivity tools.

### I. File emails to cases—quickly

Archive case interactions directly from Gmail or Outlook by filing email messages and attachments to Clio.

### II. Streamline your accounting

Sync your contacts, bills, credit notes, and payments in Clio to Quickbooks or Xero.

### III. Sync your contacts and calendars

Sync your contact list and schedule appointments from Outlook (Office 365) and Google to improve efficiencies and ensure consistency across all platforms.

### IV. Connect your document storage to Clio

Collaborate and manage your files in OneDrive, Google Drive, DropBox, Box.com, or NetDocuments—and link them to a Clio Matter for easy access.

## 4. Collaborate on cases with lawyers and staff

Our legal matter management software makes it easier to manage cases and gives every member of your law firm insight into what's happening. Therefore, making it easier to collaborate on difficult cases and help streamline the day to day running of your practice.

![](/img/1a0306233a15f236)

### I. Improve client and colleague communications

Use our software as your firm’s single source of truth. Set permissions to protect sensitive case details, and communicate with clients and co-counsel with our secure online portals, Clio for Clients and Clio for Co-Counsel.

### II. Track status updates across your firm's cases

Set the status of a case to Open, Pending, or Closed. Use notes and secure messages to easily share updates on a case. And allow collaborations between colleagues for more efficient processing of cases thanks to our state of the art legal software solution.

### III. See real-time case developments

Track every change made to a legal case including new time entries and documents. See who made what change and when. Collaborate efficiently and get the best outcome for your clients by being able to access all the documents you require to work on the case.

## 5. Configure our legal matter management software to meet your law firm's needs

Tailor our legal case management tool to your law firm's processes, and enhance the way you work, save time on menial tasks and focus on those that count for your legal practice.

![](/img/1041db897a1ee026)

### I. Standardize tracking of key case details

Create custom data fields specific to your law firm’s processes or legal practice areas to collect, store, and search for case details efficiently. Use this information for document automation.

### II. Organize cases the way you want

Attach custom categories, task lists, billing rates, payment profiles, budgets, and more to each of your legal cases.

### III. Use online intake forms to populate case profiles

Create custom online intake forms with Clio Grow and sync them to Clio Manage to streamline the client intake process.

# TIME & EXPENSE TRACKING

## I. Track every moment no matter where you are

Meet your billable targets, and don’t let a minute slip through the cracks. Spend less time tracking your hours, and more time billing for them.

![](/img/363eaf40dfcfbea6)

### a.) Record all your work

Account for everything using Clio’s time tracking software. Add time entries directly from calendar events, tasks, communication logs, notes, and documents.

### b.) Record in real-time

Use a running clock when you start a job. Pause or stop the timer when you’re interrupted, or have finished your task.

### c.) Track time from your inbox

As you send and receive emails, instantly add time entries for the time spent communicating with clients directly from Outlook or Gmail.

### d.) Add time entries from your phone

Track time and expenses while on-the-go via Clio’s mobile app. Enter time manually, duplicate a past entry, or use the in-app timer.

## II. Effortless time entry review and billing

Bill in real time, and increase your cash flow. Reduce legal billing disputes by accurately recording detailed time entries in our time tracking software.

### a.) Review and adjust time entries with ease

Correct or add time entries after the fact. For example, if you’ve accidentally forgotten to start a timer, or left a timer running, you can add or subtract minutes as needed to ensure every time entry is accurate.

### b.) See time entries through to payment

Clio’s time tracking software creates time entries that appear on your bills with a single click. Share invoices with clients and get paid 39% faster by accepting online credit card payments—all within Clio.

### c.) Set customized rates

Attach custom rates to certain time entries, matters, clients, activity categories, or users. Automatically round time entries to the increment that makes sense for your firm.

## III. Get clarity on where your time and money is going

Use Clio’s legal timekeeping software to analyze your staff’s and firm’s performance with ease. Make better decisions, and make more money.

### a.) Categorize time entries to see where your time goes

Attach UTMBS codes as you create time and expense entries to benchmark your performance and further improve billing.

### b.) See how much non-billable work you’re doing

Mark time entries as billable or non-billable. Track non-billable time against contingency or flat fee matters to ensure your law firm is taking on profitable work.

### c.) Track expenses with a few clicks

Log hard or soft cost expenses. Remove the need for expense recategorization, maintain accurate financial records, and simplify year-end reconciliations.

### d.) Generate detailed time and expense reports

Produce quick and up-to-date reports from all of the time and expense entries across your firm. Filter and group time entry metrics by date, matter, user, or status.

# CALENDARING

Stay organized on-the-go. Built for lawyers, Clio’s legal calendaring software keeps you connected to your cases, clients, and work.

## I. A legal calendar that does more than just scheduling

Use Clio’s legal calendaring software to update case milestones, share appointments with clients, and schedule multiple deadlines automatically with Court Rules.

![](/img/60d7fb76a9bc04ba)

### a.) Connect events to cases

Organize your legal calendar by case, and see your most important updates and deadlines at a glance.

### b.) Bill for every appointment

Create time entries using Clio’s legal calendaring software, and find opportunities to log more billables.

### c.) Keep clients updated

Invite clients to events, share case milestones, and keep everyone in the loop using Clio's secure client portal.

### d.) Keep tabs on your firm’s schedule

Each user in your firm can create, share, and view unlimited calendars for firm-wide meetings, intake appointments, or case-specific dates.

## II. Hit every deadline

### a.) Keep track of deadlines with Court Rules

Use Clio’s legal calendaring software to create events automatically based on rules and deadlines from hundreds of U.S. courts. Stay on top of filing deadlines, case milestones, court dates, and more.

### b.) File on time

See statute of limitations dates for all your cases. File on time and avoid malpractice claims.

### c.) Set custom reminders

Set multiple notifications—days or minutes in advance—so you never miss a meeting or deadline.

### d.) Work collaboratively in one legal calendar

Keep your colleagues, clients, and co-counsels informed on key dates with email notifications and online portal updates.

## III. Intuitive legal calendaring software

### a.) Access your legal calendar effortlessly

Create, find, and update your schedule effortlessly. Access your Clio calendar from your existing calendars and mobile apps.

### b.) Work from anywhere, anytime

Update and connect to your schedule quickly from Clio’s mobile app.

### c.) Sync all your calendars

Connect with Microsoft Outlook or Google Calendar to automatically keep your calendar current, no matter where you update it.

### d.) Connect to Clio Scheduler

Connect your calendar to Clio Scheduler, the appointment scheduling tool, that eliminates the friction and costly back-and-forth involved in booking and rescheduling appointments.

Enjoy appointment booking in the cloud that’s convenient for everyone—you, your firm, and your clients. Reduce the risk of no-shows, automate your client intake process, guarantee payment, and save time.

![](/img/0915492ba4d5bd9c)

- Stay in control of your calendar

Booking preferences mean you can prevent same day, back-to-back, or last minute appointment bookings. Optimize your day and get back the time you need to leave new clients with a great first impression.

- Reduce the friction of booking and rescheduling appointments

Manage your schedule in a way that works for you by offering available time slots in your calendar—fully accessible from an easy-to-use online booking page.

- Deliver a better client experience—in the cloud

Offer a modern, hassle-free online booking experience with easy payment options and automated appointment confirmations and reminders.

- Accept electronic credit card payments online

Combine Clio Scheduler with Clio Payments in Clio Manage—so clients can pay you the way they prefer: instantly and securely, via credit card. All in the cloud, with a few simple clicks.

- Integrate Clio’s legal appointment booking software with tools you already use

Keep record-keeping consistent across your entire firm. Clio Scheduler enables events and appointments to appear automatically in your Outlook and Google calendars.

- Keep intake details in one central, cloud-based system

Take advantage of the Clio Suite and sync Clio Scheduler with Clio Manage, so you can accept electronic credit card payments, and integrate your calendars with Outlook or Google. Avoid double bookings, manual data entry, and save time.

- Add Clio Scheduler to Google My Business and turn Google searches into clients

Potential clients can book appointments right from your Business Profile in Google with Clio Scheduler. Once an appointment is booked, a lead is added to Clio Grow making intake even easier.

# ACCOUNTING

Comply with legal industry regulations while making timely, accurate, and profitable business decisions by using Clio’s trust accounting software.

## I. Manage your trust accounting in accordance with industry rules

Manage client funds in trust accounts with our legal accounting software. Keep detailed records that separate client funds from your firm’s operating funds.

![](/img/2c5fc5919ad402be)

### a.) Set up separate ledgers for trust and operating accounts

Use Clio’s trust accounting software to create trust and operating accounts as required by legal industry regulators. See all transactions connected to a matter or client, and whether they are trust or operating account transactions.

### b.) Create invoices that comply with regulations

Present line items clearly on your legal invoices and detail funds removed from a trust, along with remaining trust account balances.

### c.) Generate reports required for trust accounting compliance

Run built-in trusting accounting reports. See all accounts and transactions associated with a client via the client ledger report, and generate client statements of account in just 3 clicks.

### d.) Reconcile accounts with ease

Use reports to conduct 3-way reconciliations manually or with the assistance of Clio’s integrations with other accounting software such as Quickbooks, Xero, and Trustbooks.

## II. Do your trust accounting with confidence

Request, apply, and transfer trust funds, while knowing all transactions are properly logged in your trust accounting software.

### a.) Make generating requests and accepting deposits easy

Send trust requests over email and allow clients the flexibility to deposit into trust accounts via online credit card, all according to legal industry rules.

### b.) Move funds in and out of trust comfortably

Create automated transaction logs as you issue trust disbursements, apply trust funds to invoices, and transfer trust funds to operating accounts.

### c.) Stay on top of your trust account balances

Use evergreen retainer management in Clio’s trust accounting software to set an alert when a trust fund drops below a certain threshold.

## III. Manage and report on all firm financials

We’re more than just trust accounting software. Clio helps you manage your firm’s profitability, compensation, financial health, and more.

### a.) Keep tabs on your firm’s financial health

Stay on top of your law firm’s work in progress, billing history, invoice payments, aging receivables, and more.

### b.) Connect your favorite accounting tools

Integrate with popular accounting tools, such as Xero or QuickBooks Online, for full general ledger legal accounting. Avoid duplicate data entry between platforms and simplify reconciliations.

### c.) Calculate attorney compensation

Summarize collected amounts by originating attorney to visualize and quantify how much income each lawyer at your firm has brought in.

# TASK MANAGEMENT

Improve productivity across your law firm. Use Clio’s task management software to organize to-do lists, see task progress, and manage your team’s workload.

![](/img/d69ccd055e670bae)

## I. Manage your tasks and close cases swiftly

Get more done—individually and as a team with Clio’s task management software.

### a.) Get insight into how a case is progressing

See all tasks for a legal matter, organized by due date. Quickly identify the next task to be done, and see which tasks are overdue.

### b.) Collaborate on tasks with anyone

Assign tasks to other users at your firm, or to outside parties through our secure client portal. Your clients can see the tasks assigned to them, receive task reminders, and mark tasks as completed.

### c.) Set custom task categories

Add as many custom task categories as you want using Advanced Tasks, or pull from existing task categories. Use these categories to standardize your law firm’s processes.

### d.) Stay on top of your to-do list

See your upcoming and overdue tasks on our main dashboard. View and mark tasks complete right from your calendar. Create tasks on your mobile phone, and create multiple reminders that appear minutes or weeks in advance.

## II. Improve your law firm’s productivity

Use Clio’s legal task management software to get more insight into your firm’s work in progress, increase your utilization rate, and forecast staff workloads.

### a.) Create standardized task lists

Build a series of tasks based on how your law firm processes different types of cases. Plus, you can now set relative task deadlines, duplicate lists and assign task lists from inside a matter.

### b.) Predict staff availability and case budgets

Add time estimates to tasks so you can forecast the amount of work needed for a legal case. Track estimates against actual time worked to better predict legal budgets for clients.

### c.) Bill more hours

Add time entries directly from a legal task, and see which tasks are missing a time entry.

### d.) Evaluate your law firm’s productivity

Manage processes across your entire firm with progress and productivity reports. See upcoming, overdue, and completed tasks on a per user basis. Filter by task category, client, matter, or date.

# ONLINE PAYMENTS

Make it easy for your clients to pay their bills online using credit, debit, or eCheck. Our built-in payments solution gets you paid faster—improving your collection rates and firm efficiency.

## I. Get paid faster, waste less time, and provide a better payment experience

![](/img/42a6a0f74daab4ca)

### a.) Handle billing and payments—all in one go

Stop struggling with disconnected workflows. Clio Payments automatically posts transactions to the appropriate matter or client account and syncs records with your accounting platform.

### b.) Flexible payment plans

Give your clients more flexibility with customized payment plans. Break large bills into manageable amounts on a schedule that fits their needs—helping you collect more of your outstanding balances.

### c.) Make it easy for clients to pay

Be client-centered by making it easy for clients to pay bills online as soon as they’re received. Accept credit, debit, or eCheck payments securely with Pay Now buttons in your electronic bills, with secure click-to-pay links embedded in emails, or over the phone.

## II. A legal payments solution your firm can trust

### a.) Real time insights into your finances

Stay on top of all your transactions with financial reports and instant payment notifications to get a real-time view of any outstanding balances. Create automated payment reminders for any bills that need additional follow-up.

### b.) The simple solution to complex trust accounting

Clio handles all trust-related transactions in compliance with trust accounting and IOLTA rules. With earned and unearned funds kept separate, funds in your trust account are protected from all third-party debiting, including processing fees and chargebacks.

### c.) Operate in accordance with PCI legislation

Clio uses the payment industry's most advanced security measures—with bank-grade protection of client data and proactive fraud detection—so you can safely accept online payments. Clients can also store card details for future transactions.

## III. Say hello to simple and transparent pricing

![](/img/4d61db4157221be1)

# INSIGHTS DASHBOARD

See how many billable hours your firm has captured, billed, and collected in one central dashboard. Identify opportunities to improve productivity, efficiency, and revenue across your firm with Clio Manage’s Firm Dashboard.

![](/img/ae26f103168d84d0)

## I. Get unique insights on how your firm is performing

Track your firm’s utilization, realization, and collection rates—how much billable work you’re doing, how much money you’re losing, and how much money you’re making—as outlined in the Legal Trends Report. Get an overview of your firm’s performance in an easy-to-understand visual dashboard.

### a.) Know where your time is going

Understand how much your firm’s work day is spent on billable work. See where you can identify opportunities to adjust workflows and better allocate resources.

### b.) See how much you could be billing

Find out how much money you may be losing due to write-offs. Get the hard numbers of which hours ends up on an invoice. Identify where your firm is doing work it doesn’t end up charging for.

## II. Understand your revenue drivers

In seconds, get insight into how your firm is performing.

### a.) Track your revenue

Understand what’s actually being collected from your invoices. Use performance metrics to see if you should be asking for larger retainers, offering flexible payment plans, and using other reliable payment methods.

### b.) Measure performance over time

Pinpoint what’s driving firm performance. See the data over a specific timeframe, and identify trends and changes over time—so you can plan annual budgets, invest in headcount, and set aside resources.

## III. Understanding key business metrics for law firm growth

According to the Legal Trends Report, utilization, realization, and collection rates are the most important indicators of law firm growth. Below are the averages across the United States.

![](/img/0e58fe9eeefe0710)

## CLIENT PORTAL

Clio for Clients is a portal designed for legal clients to securely communicate and share information with their lawyer.

![](/img/f873ec16be27c01c)

## I. What is Clio for Clients?

Clio for Clients is a new client-attorney communication portal that enables clients to work with their lawyer from anywhere.

### a.) Accessible from anywhere

Clients can communicate with their lawyer and receive case status updates from any device.

### b.) Easy, secure login

Clients will receive a signup link in an email from their lawyer. Once set up, clients can access the portal securely via Face ID or Touch ID, or their fingerprint if using the mobile app.

### c.) Mobile document scanning and uploading

Users can scan documents that are converted into a PDF and automatically cropped and adjusted for clarity. Documents can also be uploaded from other apps (e.g. Mail, Dropbox) or from the device’s camera roll.

## II. Make the most of everyone’s time

Take the review process online and eliminate the need for your clients to take a day off work just to meet with you.

![](/img/d375a4beff0465fa)

### a.) Log client communication and documents efficiently

Clients can securely send messages and attachments to you. If a client messages or shares a document with you, it will automatically be saved to their respective matter.

### b.) Eliminate unnecessary back-and-forth communication

Clients can access their case communications and documents at any time, eliminating the back-and-forth communication required of you.

## III. Stay connected to your clients

Clio for Clients makes it easy for your clients to feel connected to their lawyer and understand the progress of their case.

![](/img/b4c519d59fab5b80)

### a.) Deliver a better experience for your clients

pages.body:
## I. MICROSOFT WORD TEMPLATES

### A. MERGING DATA INTO A WORD TEMPLATE

In order to merge a field into a Word template, you simply put the field inside of brackets:

```
{{ field ID goes here }}
```

For example, if you had a sentence in your document that used a person's first name such as:

```
Thank you, Jeff, for hiring our firm.
```

You would insert the merge field in the sentence in Word as follows:

```
Thank you, {{first_name}}, for hiring our firm.
```

When this template is uploaded to Lawmatics and used on a matter, it will substitute the contact's first name where is belongs.

It is important to note that the merged data will take on any formatting that you give the bracketed placeholder in Word. If you make the field bold, **{{first_name}}, **it will be bold when the data is merged.

We have made it very easy to get the value of all your available fields for merging. Follow these steps to access your field reference.

1. Hover over the help icon in the top right of any page

![](/img/8fb93e15b74ed9b0)

2. Click on DOCX Field Reference

![](/img/d83a1cf79e17e39c)

3. You will see the names of the fields on the left and the id of the field on the right, in the white box. This value in the white box is what needs to be used in between the brackets in word.

![](/img/8539b3766587dd6c)

### B. USING CONDITIONAL LOGIC

We have also created a language that can be used in Word templates to create conditional logic. Just like you are used to with our online document editor, it is simple to create documents with dynamic data, changing depending on the value of certain fields. Below is an example of how conditional logic would look in Word.

```
{{#practice_area == Family Law}}We look forward to handling your Family Law matter.{{/practice_area}}{{#practice_area == Estate Planning}}We look forward to handling your Estate Planning matter.{{/practice_area}}
```

Let's break this down.

You can see that all information contained inside the {{}} brackets is meant to be Lawmatics "code". Information inside these brackets will be evaluated special.

The first line {{#practice_area == Family Law}} is what sets the first IF condition. This says that if the practice area is Family Law, any text before the closing brackets, {{/practice_area}}, will be used.

To create an if condition you must start with a "#" immediately followed by the field value, which again is obtained from the [DOCX Field Reference](https://app.lawmatics.com/documents/reference) mentioned above. After this opening condition, you can type all the text you would like. Then, **close** the if statement by using "/" immediately followed by the same field value.

You can create multiple if statements for the same field, enabling you to create options for each value of a field, just as demonstrated in the practice area example above.

It is also possible to create an IF NOT statement. In order to accomplish this, simply use "^" in place of "#". So, for example, the following would represent text to be used if the practice area WAS NOT Estate Planning:

```
{{^practice_area == Estate Planning}}>We look forward to handling your matter that is not Estate Planning.{{/practice_area}}
```

### C. UPLOADING TO LAWMATICS

In order to upload Word templates just follow these steps.

1. Navigate to Documents from inside the Assets tab at the top of the page.
2. Click on Create New Document in top right of screen
3. Select Upload DOCX Document

![](/img/4fd4c0333e71ed29)

4. You will then give the document a name, select the recipient type for this document (matter or contact), and then select a file already uploaded or upload the docx file right there.

![](/img/80dbdfcf16f42ea1)
Esignatures: In order to learn more about how to use esignatures inside of a Word template, please visit our help article[ here](https://lawmatics.helpscoutdocs.com/article/200-using-esignature-in-microsoft-word-documents).

## II. SENDING FORMS & DOCUMENTS TO CLIENTS

### A. MANUALLY SENDING DOCUMENTS FOR E-SIGNATURE

The easiest way to send a document to a client is to do so from their matter page. You'll do this by clicking the blue button at the very bottom of the matter that says Send Document.

You will then select the document you wish to send. This will pull up the familiar options of Signature Requester, Contact Signer 1, etc. and it will also pull up a preview of the document with this particular matter's fields merged in.

Click the Edit Before Send button to make any one-off changes to the document. These changes will not update the template, but instead will only apply to the document for this particular matter.

![](/img/677cc57c4077df85)

Click Send at the bottom once you have finished your edits, and the document will be emailed out for e-signature.

You can also send a document template from the Custom Docs page. This does not allow for one-off edits like the method above. To do this, follow these steps:

1. Hover on assets and select custom docs
2. Click the eyeball icon on the right side of the page for whichever doc you want to send
3. Use the Preview by Matter box in the top right to preview the document with a given matter’s fields merged in
4. If you notice any mistakes, go back to the matter (by searching in the search icon in the top right) and make sure to populate those fields

Once you've previewed the document and you’re ready to send, you'll click send at the bottom right. You will see the following box appear once you click send:

![](/img/1f9abd69d2c3c8de)

The number of contact signers and firm signers will vary based on the specific document. For Contact Signer 1, you’ll want to make sure you select the matter rather than the contact. If you do choose the contact, it will still send the document appropriately, but in order to see the activity of the document being sent on the matter’s timeline internally, you’ll need to select the matter.

![](/img/4093ded899196e56)

If you want to view an overview of all of the e-signature documents you sent out, you can hover on assets and go to E-Signatures. The Signature Requests section will show you all pending and completed requests. Once a document has been signed by all necessary parties, its status will change to completed and you can download it from the arrow icon on the right.

The document will also automatically save to the matter once it is completed, as long as it was sent to a matter signer.

### B. MANUALLY SENDING FORMS

If you are looking to send a form to someone who is not yet created as a matter in Lawmatics, you’ll do so by hovering on assets and selecting Custom Forms. Then, as long as the form is not internal, you can click the … icon on the right and select Share.

When the person fills out the form and submits it, a new matter will be created for them.

If you want to share a form to an already existing matter, you’ll open their matter page (by searching their name, clicking their matter on the pipeline, or from the CRM) and click Form Actions at the bottom.

From here you can either open a form to be filled out internally, or share a form directly to this matter. Sharing the form will email it to them to fill out. It will show the form share on their activity timeline, and will also automatically save the submission once they have filled out and submitted the form.

Sharing the form this way will not create a new matter, but rather will update the already existing matter.

## III. USING E-SIGNATURE IN MICROSOFT WORD DOCUMENTS

*All e-signature merge fields must be surround by double brackets, {{ }}. Failure to include those will break the merge fields.*

### A. SIGNATURE FIELDS

Signature fields have the following format: {{signer|required?|role}}. The "|" must be used as the separator for each section. The options for each section is broken down below.

**Signer**: This indicates whether the signer of this field is going to be someone at the firm (i.e a Lawmatics user) or a matter/contact. Here are the options for the Signer section:

sig = Field will be signed by a matter/contact. Someone who is not a user in Lawmatics.

sigfirm = Field will be signed by a user of Lawmatics.

**Required?**: This indicates whether the signature field is required or not. Most of the time, you will want this to be a required field. Here are the options for the Required? section:

req = The field is required.

noreq = The field is not required.

**Role**: This field will become the name of the role in Lawmatics for the signature field. You can name this field anything you want. For example, if you put "client" in this section, when sending the document for signature from Lawmatics, you will see the role Client, with a dropdown to select who you want to be the Client signer.

*The following example would be used for a firm user signer with the role name Managing Attorney {{sigfirm|req|Managing Attorney}}*

### B. NON-SIGNATURE FIELDS

Lawmatics supports the following types of fields to be included in signable Word documents: date, text input, and initials. Non-signature fields have the following format: {{type|required?|label}}

**Type**: This indicates the type of field that you are creating. Here are the options for the type section:

date = This will add a current date field to the document.

check = This will add a checkbox that the signer will be able to check.

text = This will add a text input field that the signer will be able to fill with whatever value they want.

initials = This will create a place for the signer to add their initials.

**Required?**: This indicates whether the field is required or not. Here are the options for the Required? section:

req = The field is required.

noreq = The field is not required.

**Label**: This indicates the label for the field that will appear in the Lawmatics user interface and in the document itself when the signer is filling out the field. This field needs to match the Role for the signature field corresponding to the signer who needs to fill out this field. For example, if you have a signer with role "Client", and you want that same signer to be the one to fill out this non-signature field, you would need to make the label for the non-signature field "Client" as well.

*The following example would be used for a input field that is required and to be filled out by the Managing Attorney signer: {{text|req|Managing Attorney}}*

## IV. SIGNATURE TEMPLATES vs CUSTOM DOCUMENTS

### A. SIGNATURE TEMPLATES

Templates start with a PDF file as the base, and you’ll then drag and drop fields to be merged into the template as well as signature fields to prompt where to sign. The key thing to keep in mind about templates is that you cannot make any updates/edits to the content once the PDF has been uploaded to the template.

It makes sense to use signature templates for simple forms that are very unlikely to change. For example, it would make sense to use this feature for a credit card authorization, HIPAA form, record request authorization, etc. We typically do not recommend using signature templates for your fee agreements, that is a better fit for custom documents which we also be discussing here.

You’ll start by preparing your base document. Make sure that the document does not have any fields already merged in like the current date or a client’s name. Also, make sure that it has blank spaces built in where you can merge the necessary fields. Once it is prepared, upload it as a firm file by hovering over the orange plus sign in the top right and selecting upload file.

To create the template you’ll hover on Assets and select E-Signatures, then select Create Signature Template. You will see a box similar to the one below.

![](/img/3ac6dd3de9120b78)

Give your template a name and then select your base document from the drop down list. The signer type will typically be Matter if this is a document that will be used for clients. You will also add in the appropriate number of matter and firm signers, as well as assign them a role.

When you are assigning the signers keep in mind that each signer will need to have one required signature in order to complete the template.

Once you click Create Template you will be taken to the template building canvas. You will see all of your different types of fields (signature, initials, textbox, etc) listed across the top, and you can drag them anywhere on the document.

Use the Textbox field to merge in any of your fields, such as the client’s name. To merge in a field you will start by dragging and dropping the Textbox wherever you want it. Then select Lawmatics eSigner as ‘who fills this out’ and select the field you want for ‘what text goes here’.

![](/img/4db99b2cd7b673c0)

Same thing for any of the signature fields, drag and drop the field, and then assign who needs to sign/date/initial/check in that place and whether it is required or not.

![](/img/5cbb0de0c93eb680)

Once you have finished adding all your fields you are ready to click Continue in the top right. This will save the document as a template that can either be sent as a one-off instance to a client or be built into an automation.

### B. CUSTOM DOCUMENTS

Whereas signature templates require a static base document, custom documents do not. They are living, breathing, editable documents, that you can update at any point using our built-in word processor.

You’ll find custom documents by hovering over Assets, and selecting Custom Docs. Create a new doc by selecting Create New Document in the top right. Once again you will likely create documents as Matter type and you are not required to select a practice area.

Start by dragging a Text Field from the standard blocks section. You will see that it looks similar to other word processors you might have worked with. You can copy and paste your document into the text editor, use the formatting tools provided to add bullet points, images, etc., and merge in any fields using the drop downs provided.

You can also assign the number of signers who will be signing via e-signature by clicking on Signature Settings in the top right.

![](/img/c1df89f93cfe672d)

You can also use custom docs to make conditional paragraphs. This allows you to either show or hide certain sections of the document depending on whether or not the condition applies. This could be used for certain practice areas, case types, or any other custom field.

When editing a custom doc, make sure to click ‘Save Document’ at the bottom periodically to save your work.

## IV. CUSTOM DOCUMENTS OVERVIEW (VIDEO)

[Watch here](https://help.lawmatics.com/article/164-custom-documents-overviewvideo)

## V. CREATE FEE AGREEMENT w/ CUSTOM EDITOR

**1. Navigate to the Documents section of Lawmatics**

![](/img/21dbee857a939e59)

**2. Click on Create New Document button in the upper right**

![](/img/074df553e885d488)

**3. In the popup, select Start Fresh and fill out the following fields.**

![](/img/51025c2b85c01be9)

- Make sure that Start Fresh is selected
- Give the document a name
- Select the type of record that this document will be used by. If you would like to send to a matter and have matter fields available as merge fields, select matter. If you only need contact merge fields and want to send to a contact, select contact.
- If you have selected Matter as your type, you can also choose a practice area. This will make those practice area specific custom fields available as merge fields on the document. For most documents this field can be left blank.

**4. Click Create**

**5. Add a Text Block to get started building your document. Simple drag Text Field over from the left side of the screen onto the document canvas.**

![](/img/98463445364d7432)

The document can be made up of as many text blocks as you want. This is incredibly useful when needing to build documents that have conditional paragraphs or sections.

**6. Make blocks conditional (if necessary). **Click on the gear icon to the right of any text block on your document. From there, you can set the block to appear only when certain data is matched. For example, if I only want a certain section to show on the document if the matter is a Personal Injury matter, I would click the gear, turn on conditional, select the Practice Area field and set it equal to Personal Injury. You can add multiple conditions on a single block as well.

![](/img/1ccf4e3d808b2614)

**7. Use merge fields (if necessary)**. Simple select the field you want to merge in from the merge fields dropdowns on the edit block view. Selecting the field ail automatically add it to the document wherever your cursor is currently placed.

![](/img/4ea689ceec03285b)

**8. Add signatures to the document. **

Click the Settings button in the top right under "ESIGNATURE".

![](/img/8c877bbfca825cd1)
2. Click on Add Firm Signers to add signature blocks for firm users who are going to need to sign. Click on Add Signer in to add signature blocks for client/contact signers. 3. Label each signer with the role, or title, of the signer. For example, a firm signer might be labeled "Managing Attorney" and a regular signer might be labeled "Client"

Click Apply Settings. This will create a new merge field dropdown selector labeled "Signature Fields"

![](/img/bfe23694d69a85cf)
5. Select the "Signature" from that dropdown for the role you would like to add to the document. This will place it wherever your cursor is in the same way merge fields are placed into the document.

Select the "Signature" from that dropdown for the role you would like to add to the document. This will place it wherever your cursor is in the same way merge fields are placed into the document.

![](/img/6df5087502ce9bbd)

**9. Click Save Document at bottom of screen**

## VI. HOW TO USE NEW E-SIGNATURE PLATFORM

![](/img/92580011596d3dc7)

**Signatures(Legacy):**

This is where you will find all of your pre-existing PDF uploaded signature documents. There are specifically the documents that you uploaded as PDFs and turned them into signature documents. They will continue to be sent through HelloSign for the time being. At some point, we will deprecate this functionality and you will need to recreate those documents as Lawmatics native PDF signature documents.

If you have previously created Lawmatics custom documents, those will now exist under the Documents section.

**Documents:**

This is now the hub in Lawmatics for all things documents. You can create 3 types of documents here, all of which can also have signatures added to them. Microsoft Word, PDF and Lawmatics Custom Documents. This page will also have a list of all the signature requests that you have sent you. You will see a status of the document and status for each individual signer. You can also download a copy of the document from this list.

The ability to use Microsoft Word and PDF documents in this new Documents section is still something that our team needs to turn on for you. If you currently don't see those options when creating a new document, please let us know and we will activate it for you.

## VII. CREATE FEE AGREEMENT w/ PDF BUILDER

**1. Navigate to Assets < Documents and click on Create Document in the upper left of screen**

**2. Select "Upload PDF" and fill out the information. Each field is explained below.**

1. Select Upload PDF as the type of file

![](/img/a7d2cb1f03a2a136)

- Select Upload PDF as the type of file
- Enter the name that you would like to give the document in Lawmatics
- Choose recipient type. Will you be sending to this a matter or to a contact without a matter? Most of the time you will want to select matter here. This field also dictates which merge fields are available on the document
- Select the practice area this document will be used for. Most of the time this will be left blank. This field also dictates which practice area specific fields are available for merging to the document
- Select the PDF you would like to use as the base document. You can select a file that has already been uploaded into Lawmatics or upload a new file right then
- Click Create

**3. Add any merge fields to your document**
Start by dragging a text field from the left panel onto your document where you need a merge file

![](/img/974784333933195b)

Select who will be responsible for setting the value of this field. The two options are:

![](/img/d95826cf8853df24)

**Firm User:** This means that whoever is sending the document from the firm will set the value of the field before sending the document

**Merged from Matter:** This means that the field will be automatically merged from the field selected on the matter.
*PLEASE NOTE: If you select Merged from Matter you will see an additional field show up just below the Field Set By selector. This field allows you to select the field from the matter you would like to populate this field on the document*

![](/img/786bf3fe5b9fe8e1)

Continue setting the font, font color, and font size. Then click DONE.

**4. Add signatures to the document.**
Click the Settings button in the top right under "ESIGNATURE".

![](/img/91f4e74888ad2f7b)

Click on Add Firm Signers to add signature blocks for firm users who are going to need to sign. Click on Add Signer in to add signature blocks for client/contact signers.

![](/img/7e005dfb9f53b9c7)
3. Label each signer with the role, or title, of the signer. For example, a firm signer might be labeled "Managing Attorney" and a regular signer might be labeled "Client"

Label each signer with the role, or title, of the signer. For example, a firm signer might be labeled "Managing Attorney" and a regular signer might be labeled "Client"

Add Signature fields from the left panel onto the document where you need a signature.

![](/img/ee95e058e1eb107c)
5. Select the role that will be responsible for signing in this specific signature field. You can also give the field a label so the the signer will have cleared instructions. Click DONE when ready.

Select the role that will be responsible for signing in this specific signature field. You can also give the field a label so the the signer will have cleared instructions. Click DONE when ready.

![](/img/fda6495be3522d5a)

**5. The document will save automatically. After you have added all your merge fields and the signatures that you need on this document, it is ready to be used in an automation or to be manually sent for e-signature.**

## VIII. USING E-SIGNATURES with PDF DOCUMENTS

Creating a esignature document from a PDF upload is simple in Lawmatics. This features allows you to easily automate things like court forms and other PDF documents.

1. Navigate to the Documents section under the Assets tab at the top of the screen.
2. Click on Create New Document
3. Select PDF Upload and fill out the fields required. You will need to chose, under recipient type, whether this document will be sent to Matters or Contacts individually. This will dictate what custom fields are available to merge into the document.

![](/img/becdb87ba345a959)

4. Once you click create, you will be presented with a PDF builder view, allowing you to add merge fields and other useful user inputs. In order to add signature to the document, simply click on Settings from the top right side of the builder view.

![](/img/ab1852778a9b1cb6)

5. This will open a window to add signers to the document. First, toggle Document has eSignatures? to yes. You can then add firm signers (which will be users within your Lawmatics account) and signers (which are any matter or contact signer). Each time you add a signer you will be presented with a text input in order to create the label/role of the signer.

![](/img/8109c53d374c9764)

6. Once you have added signers and clicked Apply Settings, you will see a new option on the left side of the screen under Draggable Field Types. That new option will be Signatures. Simply drag the Signature item over and onto the document wherever you want it. When you drop it, and also whenever you click it again from the document in the future, you will see an Edit Properties window. From here you can indicate who needs to sign in this space (selecting from a list of the roles you created in the previous steps) and also add a label to the signature field to make it clearer for the signer.

![](/img/99fbc5c549021296)

7. Click Done form the Edit Properties window and your document will be auto saved as you go along.

*PLEASE NOTE: Your document will warn you if you have created more signature roles than are currently merged onto the document. For example, if you add 1 firm signer and 1 client signer, but then only add a signature for the client signer on the document, the system will warn you and you will not able to send this document for signature until all signer roles are merged onto the document in at least one place.*

## IX. CUSTOM ASSET EMAILS

You can now create custom email templates for sending out your firm assets such as Custom Forms, Documents, File Requests, and Booking Forms. This gives you the opportunity to include more customized content in the email, along with the link to the asset you are sharing with the PNC.

To create your custom asset emails, start by hovering on the Assets tab, and select the type of asset you wish to create an email for. Then, click the icon and select Email Template.

![](/img/b84af8a96a2e35b3)

We'll use custom forms for this example, but you will see a similar dropdown menu as pictured above when you click the icon for your documents, file requests, and booking forms as well.

After clicking Email Template (circled above), you'll then create your plain text email template for sharing this particular form/document/etc. You can merge in fields as needed using the various field dropdown menus, and make sure you input the custom link for the asset, as shown below.

![](/img/fbfa33e45657943b)

Once you have created the email template for this particular asset, you will have the choice to use the standard Lawmatics HTML email template for sharing this asset, or you can select to use your Email Template.

![](/img/43b7d09b2e311d1c)

You will see this option when sharing the asset manually, as shown above, or when sharing the asset via automation, shown below.

![](/img/84738300e473025b)

pages.summary: Imagine all your client data, documents, notes, tasks, and client texts ALL in one place. The Vine Platform houses all your work, helps you complete more work, and makes collaboration and communication easy.
pages.body:
![](/img/5f0f8815ab859e5f)

# Overview

## I. The Vine Platform

Imagine all your client data, documents, notes, tasks, and client texts ALL in one place. The Vine Platform houses all your work, helps you complete more work, and makes collaboration and communication easy.

![](/img/5cc81c94451353f5)

Welcome to The Vine Platform. All your work. All in one place

### Your work, automated

Whether you’re managing cases, matter, documents, contracts, or client info, there are a lot of steps to your unique processes. Filevine automates your deadlines and tasks so you and your team never miss a beat.

![](/img/d968c94ccc349a9e)

### Connect and collaborate—from anywhere

No more “where are we on this???” Use the activity feed to view, comment, and complete tasks within the context of each unique case. You and your team can stay connected for every update.

![](/img/b82a3d7aa8ec8689)

### Keep your team operating at their best

Don’t waste time on busywork. With task lists, reminders, and notifications your team can focus more on what matters—delivering client results. Customize Filevine to be just as unique as your team. Use roles and permissions to control your teams’ access and responsibilities.

![](/img/c459e1d19e7e51ff)

### Retain your clients

Organize your client and contact data just the way you want so you have vital information at a glance. Quickly recall client information to ensure a personalized and efficient experience for every interaction. Text and email your clients from Filevine’s activity feed so any correspondence is tracked, stored, and viewable.

![](/img/6a8978b24b9ccefc)

## II. Lead Management

Convert more leads, simplify your intake process, and make more money. Lead Docket helps you optimize your resources and increase conversion. Customize intake forms, automate task flows, track leads, and manage marketing efforts—all in one place.

![](/img/6f328bfd00132b04)

![](/img/f48c56733e9e2609)

### Capture every lead

Never lose a lead. Track every lead from every source all the way through to conversion.

No more missing lead information. Create custom intake scripts that fit your team’s specific call flows and document leads more effectively.

![](/img/dbf7c638c58494de)

### Optimize your marketing budget

Increase your profits without increasing spending. Know exactly where your leads are coming from so you can invest where it matters most.

Lead Docket has [multiple integrations](https://www.leaddocket.com/features/) with marketing tools so your workflow doesn’t have to change.

![](/img/a45227678e3a041d)

### Never forget to follow up

Automate recurring tasks for your team to complete for each lead to ensure nothing slips through the cracks.

Timing matters. Preset your follow-up task flows and automated messaging so your lead gets the right message at the right time.

![](/img/3f3ba8066ce6e60e)

### Enhance your lead efforts through reporting

Make better business decisions. Track lead volume over time, revenue by source, and other key indicators.

Never miss an opportunity. The intake dashboard helps your team work productively by displaying goals, priorities, and tasks.

![](/img/e3f5f75df86af555)

### Refer leads efficiently

Sit back, relax, and let Lead Docket chase down referral fees and automatically check in with referral partners for you.

Save time and reduce errors by sending lead information to referral partners directly from Lead Docket.

![](/img/dcabc9d0eb0d88b9)

### Powerfully integrated with Filevine

Capture and convert leads and seamlessly transition case files, contact information, and more to Filevine.

### Entirely cloud-based

Stay on top of leads and work from anywhere. Lead Docket is a completely secure cloud-based solution.

Paired perfectly with vinesign

Generate and send contracts directly from Lead Docket when paired with our esignature tool - Vinesign

![](/img/5be0160fb4bd347f)

## III. Document Management

Eliminate errors and busywork.

Filevine’s flexible and robust document management simplifies your processes with convenient editing and collaboration tools, robust organization and search capabilities, and unlimited storage—all securely, all seamlessly built into your Filevine workflow.

![](/img/a089d0d3191d9184)

### Say goodbye to repetitive busywork

Instantly generate custom demand letters, contracts, interrogatories, firm reports, retainers and more—all with accurate client and case information with one click with DocGen. Think of all the complex documents your firm relies on—they’re now created and personalized in a snap with Filevine.

![](/img/647ab3ef6c11142c)

### Quick and thorough search

Locate any document through powerful search functionality. Search for custom document hashtags, like #retainer or #evidence, and leverage the power of OCR (optical character recognition) to locate files based on document content and keyword searches—even handwritten notes!

![](/img/d1c543ddccbdaf94)

### Collaborate and collect signatures

Simplify back and forth with powerful collaboration tools to share documents, comment, make edits, and gather signatures.

Lock your documents for editing, preventing inadvertent overwrites of your changes and protecting the integrity of each document.

![](/img/034e513e4c5334af)

### Your documents, your way

Organize your documents more effectively with Custom Folder Structures. Customize folders on a case-by-case basis or create default structures for each of your practice areas.

![](/img/df255a771d8f0054)

### Edit without leaving Filevine

Leverage all the editing capabilities you need to do your best work

1. PDF Editing - Add text, redact information, apply highlighting, attach files, insert images, change page layout, and more!
2. Doc Combiner - Combine, reorder, and insert documents to create exhibits and demand packets
3. Bates Stamping - Apply uniform, consecutive identifiers across a set of documents.

![](/img/efb0fdb7972d8aed)

### Share documents safely and securely

Protect all of your docs with user permissions, password protection, and expiration dates.

### Collaborate within Filevine - from anywhere

Streamline document-related processes within Filevine with tasks or notes and view/collaborate from anywhere.

### Unlimited storage

Store thousands of documents, images, videos, and audo files-all automatically backed up.

## IV. Contract Management

Get more legal work done each day—automatically. From generating contracts in seconds to collaborating in real-time to tracking every data point instantaneously, Outlaw automates your entire contract lifecycle, freeing you up from routine, manual document work. Do the work that matters to you, let Outlaw do the rest.

![](/img/aff5758b4c2d8443)

![](/img/2eabb41f42b7d7d2)

### Launch your contracts in seconds — not days or weeks

Contract generation has never been more flexible. Create dynamic templates with built-in conditionals to customize and auto-populate error-free legal documents instantly.

- Scale your workflows with self-service templates while reducing rogue contracts
- Batch-generate thousands of customized contracts, letters, and papers
- Import and manage third-party documents and workflows with ease

![](/img/58a4cb96921a84a7)

### Review, redline and revise together — all in one place

Align on strategic documents together on the most productive environment you’ve ever seen. Reach agreement faster when your teams are in lockstep.

- Built-in redlining and section-specific version histories
- Automated approval workflows & real-time alerts
- Concurrent, multi-party editing and threaded commenting

![](/img/6589578b43cc7ae0)

### Ensure compliance with all interactions tracked and stored

Maintain control while accelerating your team’s workflows. Keep track of all contract evolutions in one place, and never lose sight of another version or deadline again.

- Cloud-based audit trail & version control
- Set custom alerts based on variables such as expiry and renewal dates
- Track critical legal obligations in convenient dashboard snapshots

![](/img/5ed8b580610d692c)

### Data retrieval and insights at your fingertips

Store data and achieve full visibility across your entire contract universe. Advanced reporting enables you to unlock the critical business intelligence that lives within your contracts in seconds.

- AI-powered full-text and parametric search
- Personalized tags & dynamic foldering for quick access
- Transfer your legacy contracts with all metadata automatically captured

## V. Business Analytics

Better understanding of your data = better firm performance. Your firm generates a massive amount of information and every piece of data is an opportunity to earn more revenue and improve efficiency. Filevine surfaces your data so you can make informed decisions on hiring, caseloads, staff performance, and firm success.

![](/img/34093f1f06178b49)

### Report on any data point in the system

Everything in Filevine is reportable, from notes and tasks to field entries and calendar events. By centralizing your work into one seamless system, all your data becomes actionable!

Confidently answer questions like “when should I hire?”, “where are most of my cases coming from”, and “where should I spend my marketing dollars?” using business analytics.

![](/img/e8fc7db314555b67)

### Fully automate your reporting

Configure your reports to auto-deliver to your email inbox exactly when you need them. Get info whenever you want it — whether you’re hosting a townhall for your firm, meeting with your executive team, or conducting annual planning.

![](/img/c9e86c63aae9c387)

### Increase staff productivity

Who are my best performers and who is falling behind?

Use audit reports to identify your top performers and highlight training opportunities. Compare task completion rates, cumulative actions taken, and other factors to ensure your team is performing at its best.

![](/img/1074a779a9edd110)

### Arm yourself for the future

Prepare for the future with data-backed insights about your team, caseload, and law firm as a whole.

Expansive criteria options let you limit report results by any factor or condition. Maybe you only want to see cases that haven’t been touched in 30 days or clients who have contacted you in the past week. You control your data.

![](/img/6727f2bafe1deb81)

### Easily visualize your data

Power-up with Filevine Periscope to see your data in a whole new way. Drill-down in any dashboard to see raw data-sets and visualize them in any way you want, like pie charts or bar graphs.

![](/img/e99bd19397495a80)

## VI. Billing & Time - Keeping

Take control of your time and your firm’s financial future with automated time-tracking and invoice generation.

Use a project’s collection sections to manage massive sets of similar but unique information, like medical records, client expenses, case fees, and more.

### Track your billable hours contemporaneously

Deploy the Timer from anywhere in Filevine and start tracking billable hours in moments. Easily stop and start the timer and seamlessly switch between clients without losing accuracy.

![](/img/dc4cb661610bba44)

### Set custom hourly rates for every member of your team

Define custom hourly rates for each of your team members. These will be factored into billing calculations automatically whenever they launch the timer or create an invoice.

![](/img/7a1f676b295f3ce1)

### Simplify your expenses

Tracking case expenses is a routine task that eats up too much time. Streamline your expense-tracking with Filevine’s innovative management tools.

![](/img/681fae3e07e25344)

### Easily track case expenses

Keep expenses under control with Filevine’s customizable expense templates. Set default expenses to allow your team to choose common items from a list rather than entering the same information every time.

![](/img/e65b02478cc16e2c)

### Access expenses from anywhere

Filevine is 100% cloud-based, allowing you to view and track expenses from anywhere using a computer, phone, or tablet. Sort or filter case expenses and expand or reduce your view to quickly see what you need to see.

![](/img/a97d70977e0d434d)

### Generate invoices with a single click

Save valuable time with Filevine’s streamlined invoice creation. Most invoices can be generated with a single click, while more complex invoices are easily handled by our powerful invoice management tools.

![](/img/23050b01fe46affb)

### Track payments automatically

Filevine will automatically match payments made in the system to the correct invoice, keeping busywork to a minimum and simplifying your billing processes.

![](/img/0288d38527427df7)

### Send invoices directly from Filevine

Once an invoice is generated, it is immediately available to send to your client. Filevine Fax lets you send and receive invoices directly within your case management system. You can also send invoices via email, or print them for posting.

![](/img/bcd94961596da335)

### Manage billing processes firm-wide

Monitor payments and invoices with our billing control panel. Create, send, and review invoices for all of your clients in one place. You can also sort and filter your invoices to find what you need more quickly.

![](/img/f479e4bf7c1c2157)

### Integrate with top-tier accounting software

Filevine offers a robust accounting integration with Quickbooks through Filevine's Check Requests Portal, which intermediates between case managers and their accounting department.

![](/img/f60ae8c22215b4d9)

## VII. eSignatures

Streamline your contracts and collect signatures faster than ever before. Vinesign improves your client’s experience and helps you save time and money. Set up templates, send documents, collect signatures, and more — all integrated seamlessly with Filevine.

Vinesign utilizes texting or email to quickly collect signatures and reduce wait times.

![](/img/fa985815214675d5)

### Convenient for you, convenient for your client

Over 98% of all text messages are opened, compared to 40% of emails. Take advantage of the ease and speed of text messaging to get documents signed faster.

Signers can draw, type, or upload an image of their signature. No matter what, you’ll always collect an accurate and usable signature.

Sign with a selfie

Add an extra level of security with gesture authentication and require the recipient to upload a photo of themselves making a randomized gesture.

![](/img/6407aa66c74757b2)

### Save time and generate documents faster

Speed up signature collection with reusable templates for your most popular documents. Designate up to four signers on a single document.

Drag and drop custom fields for dates, signatures, initials, and more.

![](/img/20106734b11b3fb5)

### Track all of your documents in one place

Follow the progress of your document. Watch as your document is sent, received, signed, and returned to you.

Never miss an update with instant notifications. Track when your document is viewed and get a notification email when someone signs.

![](/img/42faf71631068354)

### Consolidate your work

Vinesign’s integration with Filevine helps you do more with less by keeping your work all in one system.

Never forget to upload a document. Vinesign automatically saves all of your contracts and documents to the appropriate project within Filevine.

Send documents, receive confirmations, and keep everything organized without ever leaving Filevine.

![](/img/8af7a0f98c912c08)

pages.title: IMMIGRATION LAW
pages.summary: Immigration Law is the legal practice area that refers to the rules and regulations that were established by federal government of the United States for determining who are allowed to enter the country for a duration …
pages.body:
***Immigration Law * **is the legal practice area that refers to the rules and regulations that were established by federal government of the United States for determining who are allowed to enter the country for a duration of time. It also carries out the naturalisation process for those who aspire to become U.S. citizens. Other than this, immigration law also controls the detention and removal of legal rights of foreign nationals when they enter the state without permission or when they overstay their visit.

**Immigration Law Process:**

![](/img/c741a0bdc606efee)

***PERMANENT RESIDENCY AND CITIZENSHIP***

The most common ground for granting the legal status is family-based immigration, which begins when a permanent resident or a U.S. citizen files for a petition on behalf of a family member in another foreign country or in their place of origin.

U.S. citizens can also sponsor their family members who are considered to be "immediate family members." These may include U.S. citizens' spouses, parents of a citizen 21 years older, an unmarried children younger than the age of 21 years old, and children adopted before they turn the age of 16.

On the contrary, petitions filed by U.S. citizens on behalf of a "more distant relative" are subjected to annual quotas--meaning, these distant relatives must wait for a certain period to come to the United States as there will be different categories that they may fall under. Usually, unmarried children at the age of 21 or older are given the most preference, while siblings of adult U.S. citizens are given the least preference. For those included in the lowest preference, it usually takes years to obtain a U.S. Visa.

***NATURALISATION or CITIZENSHIP LAW***

It deals with the legal process of a person taking on citizenship in a country other than their own birthplace. The process of becoming a U.S citizen of another country is called **naturalisation**, while citizenship is technically includes the scope of the body of rights, privileges, and duties a naturalised citizen obtains.

The **Immigration and Nationality Act** is the primary source of American naturalisation and citizenship law. Generally speaking, a person can become a United States citizen in one of four ways:

1. By being born in the United States (or one of its territories);
2. By being born to parents who are U.S. citizens;
3. By being naturalised (which usually involves specific residency requirements and passing a citizenship test);
4. By being a minor and having one or more of your parents become naturalised citizens.

A ***Green Card*** is a common term for the document granting formal permission to a resident alien to remain in the United States permanently. A Green Card holder (i.e., the permanent resident) is someone who has been granted authorisation to live and work in the United States permanently. One can become a permanent resident (Green Card holder) in several different ways.

Most granted Green Cardholder status is sponsored by a family member or employer in the United States. Others acquire Green Cards due to refugee or asylum status or other humanitarian programs or can apply on their own.

For them to to retain permanent resident status, a person should not move to another country to remain there permanently, to remain outside the U.S. for more than a year, failure to file tax returns, or to declare themselves as "non-resident" on their tax returns.

**It should be noted that the immigration process for asylum-seekers and refugees is a whole other matter** — refugees, for instance, don't necessarily choose to come to the U.S. The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees determines which countries they are placed in.

Like the caravan migrants, asylum-seekers typically do choose the U.S., but they'll be deported if they can't prove they have a credible fear of facing persecution or torture in their home countries.

REFERENCES:
